requiredBeforeInstallationAcceptance.reason: An approved current schema baseline, migration ledger, role mapping and reviewed forward-only plan are required. Empty-database lexical replay is not supported.

Installed Oracle worker source, exact dependency lock and checkpoint assets are not in this repository. Supply and qualify a worker image implementing the current socket contract at revision 1c5edc17a7acd8701df6fc341c0d179f1c62c982.
PulseAiExternalHttpsRuntimePolicy and LayaDecisionTransport still authorize the Oracle hostname. A reviewed explicit OpenCloud development policy is required; no DNS/TLS/SSRF bypass is included.

Oracle schedule/reconcile/update/backup services use systemd and host paths. Container-aware, least-privilege maintenance and restore must be implemented. The candidate returns 503 for maintenance requests rather than claiming a schedule was applied.
Inventory active secret providers, preserve existing encryption keys and authorize an OpenCloud secret provider where required. Do not change a database-derived integration key accidentally.
Select the target architecture and approved image registry, complete scans, publish immutable image digests, and provision the approved model assets. CI image builds do not publish images.

Corporate SSO authorization, scoped runner, environment protections and image access must be configured. Mirror code is unchanged; no new writer to corporate main or live deployment trigger is installed.
DNS/certificates/SSO callbacks, outbound queue isolation, persistence/restore, role workflows, live AI and target-host capacity require verification.
